text:
ravi: heads up: SAST spikes failing after yesterday's keystore RBAC prune. error in pipeline: KMS decrypt denied.
sasha: saw it too. job `sast-ci/2026-03-22-01` failing on redwood-common.
anita: which principal? iirc we removed some key-level bindings in PR #1330.
devsec-bot: Alert: KMS_DECRYPT_DENIED affecting repos: redwood-common, inference-sdk. Signature KMS_KEY_BINDING_MISSING.
ops: paste of error: `{"code":"AccessDenied","msg":"permission denied for cryptoKey projects/redwood/.../scan-key"}`
carla: i'm the owner for scan-key, can rebind. but let's be careful — we pruned to tighten access.
tim: quick mitigation options: 1) rebind scanner SA to key (fast), 2) run offline SAST runner (no keystore), 3) delay nightly until RBAC patching window.
ravi: prefer rebind + postmortem to avoid blocking triage. can you add audit note?
carla: rebind done at ts=4860003180. devsec-bot: Audit Event: role.bind key=projects/redwood/.../scan-key -> serviceAccount:scanner@redwood-inference by carla@redwood.com ts=4860003180
sasha: reran job -> artifacts now produced but one high finding flagged (path traversal) in inference-sdk.
anita: i'll triage that finding; initial look suggests SAST rule match but runtime sanitization exists. mark as `security:needs-evidence`.
tim: propose we add CI preflight step: `keystore decrypt sample-blob` using both runner and ephemeral SA. fails fast on RBAC regressions.
carla: also adding to RBAC change checklist: list affected service accounts and include keystore key ACLs.
devsec-bot: Action items queued: (1) anita add triage evidence comment template (2) tim add keystore-preflight job (3) carla update RBAC playbook.
ravi: thanks all — will follow up on ticket SEC-2301.
